content: {"reasoning":"The retroactive authorization window is closed, and without a denial neither an appeal nor peer-to-peer review is available. An initial submission remains within timely filing and can establish primary adjudication before any appeal or secondary billing; billing the entire balance to the patient would exceed the established contractual patient share. Submit clean is preferable to attaching records because similar claims paid more often with clean submission (6/17 versus 1/6), and no claim-data correction is indicated.","action":"submit_clean"}
